query:
SELECT DISTINCT i.productName, i.costPrice, i.quantity, (i.costPrice * i.quantity) as value,
  CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM sales_transactions s WHERE s.productName = i.productName AND s.branchId = 20 AND s.createdAt >= '2026-05-01' AND s.createdAt < '2026-06-01') THEN 'HAS SALES' ELSE 'NO SALES' END as salesStatus
FROM inventory i
WHERE i.branchId = 20 AND i.createdAt >= '2026-05-01' AND i.createdAt < '2026-06-01'
ORDER BY i.productName;
